content.text: Oe BAWIPA Cathut, moipathungnae katawnkung,
Oe Cathut moipathungnae katawnkung, ang haw.
Talai taminaw lawkcengkung,
thaw haw, ka kâoupnaw hah moipathung haw.
Oe BAWIPA, tamikathoutnaw teh nâtotouh ne,
nâtotouh ne a lunghawi awh han vai.
A ngai patetlah lawk a dei awh teh,
a lawk a hram awh teh,
nâtotouh ne a kâoup awh han vai.
Oe BAWIPA, na taminaw hah a pacekpahlek awh teh,
nange râw hah a rektap awh.
Lahmainu hoi imyinnaw hah a thei awh teh,
na pa kaawm hoeh e naw hah ouk a thei awh.
BAWIPA ni hmawt mahoeh,
Jakop Cathut ni hai panuek mahoeh ati awh.
Maya thung dawk e tamipathunaw,
panuek awh haw,
Nâtuek maw na lungang awh han vai.
Thainae hnâ kasakkung ni thai mahoeh ou.
Mit kasakkung ni hmawt mahoeh ou.
Miphunnaw kacangkhaikung hoi
panuenae kacangkhaikung ni panuek mahoeh ou.
BAWIPA ni taminaw e pouknae
banghai bang hoeh e hah a panue.
Oe BAWIPA, na kâlawk dawk hoi na cangkhai teh,
na yue e naw teh a yawkahawi e lah ao.
Tamikathout hanelah tangkom tai hoehroukrak,
runae dawk hoi na kâhat sak thai mahoeh.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, BAWIPA ni
a taminaw hah hnoun mahoeh,
a râw takhoe mahoeh.
Hatei, tamikalan koe lawkcengnae ban vaiteh,
a lungthin kalan e pueng ni a tarawi awh han.
Yonnae kasaknaw taran hanelah
apimouh kai hanlah ka thaw han.
Payonnae kasaknaw taran hanelah
apimaw kai yueng lah kangdout han.
BAWIPA teh kabawmkung lah awm hoeh pawiteh,
duem onae koe ka hringnae yout kahmat han doeh toe.
Kangduenae hawihoeh ka tet pawiteh,
Oe BAWIPA, na lungmanae ni na kuet han.
Ka lung mak pathu navah,
lung na pahawinae ni ka lung ahawi sak.
Payonnae bawitungkhung,
hawihoehnae phung hai a sak awh e teh,
nang hoi kâhuiko thai han vaimoe.
Ayânaw hringnae taranlahoi a kâhmo teh,
yonnae ka tawn hoeh naw hah yon a pen awh.
Hatei, BAWIPA teh ka kânguenae doeh.
Ka Cathut teh ka lungsong doeh.
A payonnae hah amamouh lathueng phat sak nateh,
hawihoehnae a sak awh lahun nah
koung a tâtueng awh han.
BAWIPA maimae Cathut ni koung a tâtueng awh han.
